reasons: The cited clause auto-renews for successive 1-year terms with the only post-Initial-Term exit requiring ninety (90) days' written notice, which exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal window, so the deviation classification is correct (and correctly characterised as at, not beyond, the 90-day walk-away line).

The redline is minimal and directionally correct: it changes only the notice period to thirty (30) days and clarifies the right may be exercised as a non-renewal election, leaving renewal term length (already acceptable at 1 year) and all other operative language untouched (changed-character ratio 0.29 reflects a single targeted sentence edit).

Rationale properly treats the absent vendor reminder as a minor sub-element and correctly explains that the CPI/3% uplift cap is not engaged because pricing is a revenue share with no unilateral uplift mechanic, avoiding over-flagging.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, cites the playbook position (30-day preferred / 60-day fallback) and offers the 60-day fallback, consistent with the required tone and prefix.
